body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ has reopened its Country Office in Damascus in September 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

The Return and Reintegration project aims to support national and local actors in Syria in ensuring that return and reintegration processes are coordinated, inclusive, and responsive to identified needs, thereby contributing to socio-economic development and increased social cohesion. Adopting a multi-level approach, the project seeks to facilitate the sustainable integration of returnees, internally displaced persons, and host communities through improved access to basic services, enhanced economic reintegration opportunities, and the promotion of social cohesion. In parallel, the project aims to strengthen the capacities of national and local stakeholders in the planning, coordination, and management of return and reintegration activities.

**Your tasks**

- Provide continuous technical and process-oriented advice to sub-national state structures at governorate, district, sub-district, and community level on improving the availability and quality of data on return and reintegration, including indicator definition, data-collection instruments, data-quality assurance, analysis, and reporting.
- Support partner structures in establishing and operationalising a digitalised data flow between the different sub-national governance levels, and advise on the use of return and reintegration data for planning, coordination, and evidence-based decision-making; continuously assess options for linking the data-management system to the national level.
- Advise local authorities and civil society structures in selected communities on participatory processes for identifying, prioritising, and implementing low-threshold, barrier-free, public-good-oriented measures together with the different population groups, including returnees, internally displaced persons, and host community members.
- Support partner structures in strengthening horizontal and vertical social cohesion through these measures, and advise on the design and implementation of social-cohesion monitoring, including perception surveys and qualitative approaches capturing relations between population groups and between citizens and their local representatives.
- Prepare, moderate, and follow up on peer-learning formats and exchange events for decentralised state structures, in order to make learning experiences usable for the wider transition process.
- Contribute to monitoring of activities and indicators, prepare technical inputs for reports, and document good practices and lessons learned, ensuring the consistent application of conflict-sensitive, do-no-harm, and gender-responsive approaches

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- Advanced university degree in a field relevant to monitoring and evaluation, data analysis, public administration, governance, or development cooperation.
- At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in monitoring and evaluation, data management, institutional capacity development, or governance-related advisory work, preferably within development cooperation or reform contexts.
- Substantial experience in designing and managing results-based monitoring systems, including qualitative and quantitative indicators, data-collection methods, data-quality assurance, analysis, and reporting.
- Proven ability to develop practical, preferably digital, data-management systems and to support public institutions in using data for planning, coordination, and decision-making across administrative levels.
- Strong experience in institutional capacity development, including translating capacity assessments into practical systems, procedures, training, and advisory support.
- Demonstrated experience advising and maintaining constructive working relationships with government institutions, particularly at governorate, district, sub-district, or municipal level.
- Experience in participatory local development and community-based measures, and in monitoring social-cohesion outcomes, including relations between population groups and between citizens and state institutions.
- Proven ability to work in politically sensitive, fragile, or conflict-affected contexts and to apply gender-responsive, conflict-sensitive, and do-no-harm approaches.
- Strong analytical, advisory, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to bring together government institutions, civil society, and different population groups.
- Knowledge of return and reintegration dynamics and of the Syrian context, including sub-national governance structures, is highly desirable.

title: Local Economic Development Advisor
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organisations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ plans to reopen its Country Office in Damascus in 2026. It is currently implementing projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

The *Strengthening Socioeconomic Resilience* (SERNOS) project aims at improving the socioeconomic conditions for vulnerable groups, such as internally displaced persons, returnees, host communities, women and youth. The project implements the approach of Transitional Development Assistance (TDA), supporting a structure-building environment for local economic growth and development. This is done by strengthening organisational and business capacities of collective economic structures, as well as supporting actors to shape peaceful participation and decision-making processes. The project implements in partnership with civil society and non-governmental organisations in several governorates in Syria.

Within SERNOS, the Local Economic Development Advisor is responsible for the project’s activities that strengthen the organisational, entrepreneurial and social capacities of collectively organised actors, such as savings groups, women’s groups, cooperatives and self-help organisations, market committees and business incubators.

**Your tasks**

- Developing and steering project activities that strengthen collectively organised actors and their members, and advising partner organisations on their implementation
- Advising partners and supported structures on organisational development (e.g. roles, decision-making and standard operating procedures), on services for their members such as savings and lending, dispute handling and access to basic services, on income-generating initiatives, and on representing their members’ interests towards local administrative structures
- Steering the development of partner proposals, operational and budget plans according to GIZ standards for concluding financing arrangements, and accompanying partners throughout implementation
- Monitoring and reporting on the implementation of partner activities and contributing to project reporting
- Facilitating exchange and peer learning among supported structures and partner organisations, and coordinating with other GIZ projects and actors working on local economic development in the project locations
- Ensuring conflict sensitivity, gender equality and the inclusion of persons with disabilities across the activities in the area of responsibility
- Supporting the team in records management, in particular in keeping the project’s MS Teams environment and Centralised Organisation of Records well structured and in ensuring that project documentation is complete and filed in line with GIZ standards
- Supporting the management in the strategic and technical development of the SERNOS project
- Where appropriate and reasonable, performing additional tasks upon request of the management

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- University degree in economics, social sciences, agriculture, development studies or in a relevant field
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable position working on local economic development, community-based savings and lending, cooperative or association development, or support to micro and small enterprises
- Demonstrated experience with participatory approaches and social cohesion or conflict-sensitive programming
- Professional experience in working and cooperating with Syrian and international implementing organisations
- Experience in implementing project activities in the framework of financing arrangements with national and international public benefit organisations
- Political sensitivity and analytical thinking, consulting, communication and cooperation skills as well as intercultural competence
- Willingness to travel regularly to project locations across Syria
- Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Arabic, knowledge of Kurdish or German is an asset

title: Health Advisor for Emergency Medical Systems
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
**Job description**

GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ reopens its Country Office in Damascus in 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

**Your tasks**

- Provide strategic, technical, and process-oriented advice on the analysis, optimization, and implementation of emergency referral pathways and emergency medical services.
- Advise on the development, revision, and implementation of evidence-based national standards for emergency medical services and patient transport, including systems for quality assurance, data collection, validation, analysis, monitoring, and continuous quality improvement.
- Coordinate the implementation of activities related to the procurement, deployment, and operationalization of emergency vehicles and medical and non-medical equipment, as well as the institutionalization of related maintenance management and operating costs into the regular health budgets.
- Provide technical advisory support for the revision and further development of training, continuing education, and professional development curricula for relevant occupational groups, including referral coordinators, drivers, paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and incident commanders.
- Advise on the renovation, equipping, and operational strengthening of dispatch centers and coordination offices, including the central building of ambulance and referral system.
- Establish and maintain effective working relationships with the Ministry of Health, relevant government institutions, training institutions, service providers, technical experts, and other project partners to facilitate coordinated implementation and achievement of agreed results.
- Monitor, prepare and contribute to regular progress reports, implementation plans, technical documentation, and other project and indicator reporting requirements.

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- Advanced degree in medicine, emergency care, public health, health management or a related field.
- At least 7 years of progressive experience in the development, implementation or reform of emergency care systems, patient ambulance referral systems or pre-hospital care.
- Demonstrated experience with national emergency service strategies, implementation of protocols and quality assurance for pre-hospital care and patient management.
- Practice in curricula development, training and further education of relevant professional groups (e.g. control center personnel, drivers, EMT/paramedics, incident management).
- Several years of experience in working with health ministries and government agencies as well as in stakeholder and partner management.
- In-depth knowledge of the Syrian Emergency Care System, standards and frameworks.
- Strong understanding of inclusive HR processes and gender-responsive, disability-inclusive approaches in health workforce development.
- Experience with procurement and lifecycle management for emergency equipment and medical devices is an asset
- Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Arabic, knowledge of German is an asset

title: Public Finance and Institutional Coordination Advisor
source: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
body:
GIZ has been operating in Syria since 1976. It has thus established valuable contacts in civil society and garnered experience that is now crucial for supporting the country. From 2013 onwards, it worked without government involvement with the assistance of local non-governmental organizations. Despite the difficult conditions, GIZ has consistently contributed to improving people’s living conditions.

In view of the developments since December 2024, which have led Syria into a decisive phase of transformation, GIZ has reopened its Country Office in Damascus in September 2026. It is currently implementing 14 projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Federal Foreign Office (FFO), with co-financing from the European Union and other donors. From 2026, the portfolio is planned to be expanded by several new projects.

**Your tasks**

- Provide technical advise on Good Financial Governance and local governance, clarifying mandates and aligning subnational operations with national frameworks; facilitate inclusive, context-sensitive coordination bodies.
- Advise on mapping and re-designing inter-institutional roles, interfaces and procedures across national–subnational levels (e.g. budget planning/execution, treasury, procurement and transparency of local spending), co-developing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and communication pathways to improve vertical/horizontal coordination.
- Advise on practical, context-specific strategies and approaches for data collection for local economic development, budgeting on local level and local governance procedures.
- Advise on feasible digital information and coordination tools and data use for monitoring, accountability and adaptive management, workflow (documentation, approvals, reporting) that respect data protection, security and interoperability constraints in the Syrian context.
- Build partner capacities through tailored trainings, on-the-job coaching and mentoring on financial/administrative processes, coordination and communication standards; develop practical guidance and SOPs trainings and mentoring.
- Apply do-no-harm and integrity/compliance standards in all advisory work on institutional, staffing and financial structures.
- Closely coordinate with the responsible colleagues for participatory approaches and further beyond the project, supporting the Syrian portfolio on good governance and participatory instruments.
- Document and share lessons learned across outputs, projects and partners.

**Your profile (required qualifications, competencies and experience)**

- University degree (Masters level) in public administration, economics/business, political science, public finance, governance or a related field.
- At least 10 years of professional experience:
- Public finance and public administration reforms (e.g. budget planning/execution, ex-ante/ex-post controls, external audit, subnational finance), preferably in fragile/conflict-affected contexts.
- Designing and facilitating inter-institutional coordination mechanisms across government and administrative levels (decentralization, local governance).
- Developing and implementing standardized administrative and communication processes (SOPs), including digitally supported workflows.
- Solid expertise in Good Financial Governance (transparency, accountability, integrity, participation) and anti-corruption/integrity standards; ability to mainstream these across reform measures.
- At least 2 years experience with learning-oriented steering, M&E and data-driven decision-making; affinity for digital information and coordination systems.
- At least 2 years experience working with international organizations, development cooperation projects, or donor-funded programs, preferably GIZ or comparable agencies.
- Strong context- and conflict sensitivity, political sensitivity and analytical thinking, consulting, communication and cooperation skills as well as intercultural competence.
- Strong organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a complex working environment, are essential.
- High motivation, reliability, and the ability to work in politically sensitive and rapidly changing contexts while maintaining professionalism, discretion, and adherence to communication standards are expected
- Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Arabic, knowledge of German is an asset.
- Duty Station is Damascus with regular travel to partner governorates in Syria (subject to clearance)

title: Finance Manager Nigeria Abuja
body:
**About the Context**

Nigeria continues to face a complex and protracted humanitarian crisis driven by armed conflict, insecurity, climate-related shocks, displacement, and economic challenges. The Northeast remains the epicentre of the crisis, where years of conflict have displaced millions of people and disrupted access to basic services, livelihoods, and protection. In addition, increasing levels of violence and displacement in the Northwest and North Central regions, alongside recurrent flooding and food insecurity, have further exacerbated protection and humanitarian needs across the country. The 2026 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan estimates that 5.9 Million people are in need of humanitarian assistance.

The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) has been operating in Nigeria since 2015, delivering humanitarian assistance and durable solutions to conflict-affected and displaced populations. NRC works across multiple core competencies, including Education, Information, Counselling and Legal Assistance (ICLA), Shelter, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), and Protection from Violence. Through direct implementation and partnerships, NRC supports displaced persons, returnees, and vulnerable host communities to meet their immediate needs, strengthen resilience, and pursue long-term recovery and self-reliance. NRC is committed to principled humanitarian action, safeguarding, accountability to affected populations, and ensuring that assistance reaches those most in need.

The purpose of the Finance function is to ensure the financial sustainability and integrity of the organization by managing its resources effectively, providing accurate financial reporting, and ensuring compliance with all legal, regulatory, and donor requirements. The function works in partnership with the other operational departments globally and in countries to enable NRC's mission.

The function is crucial for stewardship of organizational assets, providing strategic financial planning and analysis, managing internal controls, maximizing resource utilization, and ensuring accountability to all stakeholders.

Find out more about NRC [https://www.nrc.no/](https://www.nrc.no/%22%20/t%20%22_blank) and Watch this short video to see NRC in action [https://vimeo.com/736782633](https://vimeo.com/736782633%22%20/t%20%22_blank)

**What we are looking for**

The Finance Manager is responsible for ensuring a functional finance structure in the country office, following organisational minimum standards. The role works towards providing optimal support to programme implementation and other functions within the structure. The position holder plays a key role in financial planning and analysis and the allocation of financial resources to the different areas of implementation.

**What you will do**

1. Oversee the implementation of all Finance related policies, procedures, strategies, and initiatives in coordination with the Finance team in country and area offices to ensure success, consistency, and compliance.
2. Line management responsibility for direct reporting staff and technical supervision responsibility for finance staff in area offices based on the NRC Technical Supervision. Guidelines. This includes: 
    - Performance management process setting clear goals aligned to strategic priorities and follow up and support staff’s achievement.
    - Workforce planning, recruitment, staff induction and development, and support for Duty of Care.
3. Develop and maintain country financial documents, procedures, guidance, and tools, including strategy, ensuring consistency across the country programme and in line with organisational standards.
4. Maintain the country’s overall budget control and monitor cash flows.
5. Ensure that budgeting, accounting, year-end procedures, and other financial processes take place in adherence to Financial Handbook, NRC policies, and donor and auditor requirements.
6. Train and develop NRC staff and partners’ capacity on financial and budgeting responsibilities.
7. Carry out a proper implementation for the Anti-Corruption Policy within all finance operations and activities.

**What you will bring**

**1.Professional Competencies**

- Minimum three years of experience working in a senior finance role with managerial responsibility in a humanitarian/recovery context.
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
- Working proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

***Context Related Skills, Knowledge, and Experience***

- Previous experience within the Central and West Africa region is preferable.
- Working proficiency in English both written and verbal.
- Experience in risk management with implementing partners.
- Experience in remote management.

**2.Behavioural Competencies**

- Handling insecure environment
- Planning and delivering results
- Working with People
- Analysing
- Communicating with impact and respect
- Coping with change

***Leadership Profile Competencies***

- Build meaningful relations
- Empower people
- Deliver results
- Act with integrity

Find more details [Finance Manager JD. Nigeria.pdf](https://norwegianrefugeecouncil.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/JDsforNRCPeople/IQA-TmJhBJWJTrNoLWd5qjhXAeTjsM_WbJm7YyA_pmBf9lY?e=9Da0UT)

**What we offer**

- Duty station: Abuja, Nigeria
- Contract: 24 months renewable
- Salary&benefits: grade 9 on NRC’s salary scale (The contract can be national/resident and/or international/mobile depending on final selected profile)
- NRC is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to diversity without distinction to age, gender, religion, ethnicity, nationality, and physical ability.
- We think outside the box, encourage ideas, and give responsibility to all employees at all levels. You will have many opportunities to be heard and take the initiative.
- Find out more about the benefits of working for NRC [https://www.nrc.no/career/what-we-offer/](https://www.nrc.no/career/what-we-offer/)
- Kindly send any questions about the application process to: ***cwa.recruitment@nrc.no***. *Applications sent via email will not be accepted. Please check your application status on your NRC application profile.*

title: FACE-TO-FACE FUNDRAISER
body:
## **MSF Eastern Africa is looking for a Face-to-Face Fundraiser**

*Do your skills and experience not precisely match the requirements? At MSF EA, we strive to create a safe, diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing the need to increase access to professional opportunities for historically underrepresented groups. If you're interested in this position but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the selection criteria, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the ideal candidate for this or other positions.*

*Firmly committed to safeguarding patients, community members, staff, and all those in contact with the organization from all forms of abuse, including sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (SEAH), we will take all necessary steps, through rigorous vetting processes, to ensure that confirmed perpetrators of abuse do not join the organization.*

*For this position, contact level with patients and children is categorized as **Low Risk** and will be monitored with this in regard.*

## ***Introduction***

Médecins Sans Frontières/Doctors Without Borders (MSF) is an international independent medical humanitarian organisation that provides assistance to people affected by conflicts, epidemics, and natural or human-made disasters and excluded from healthcare. We provide this assistance without discrimination, irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation.

## ***About MSF Eastern Africa***

MSF Eastern Africa is the regional institutional office of MSF. It focuses on representation and networking, recruiting and supporting staff from the region, communications and fundraising, as well as working on other dossiers of importance to MSF such as Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI), Data Protection, mutualization, training, medical operational support and environmental health.

## ***Rationale/Objective for Position***

The Face-to-Face Fundraiser is responsible for representing MSF in public-facing locations, engaging members of the public in informed and meaningful conversations about MSF's humanitarian work and converting interested individuals into committed regular donors and single-gift donors through approved channels.

This position will be **hierarchically** and **functionally** accountable to the **Donor Relationship Manager**.

## ***Tasks & Responsibilities***

***Public Engagement & Donor Acquisition***

- Approach and engage members of the public at assigned deployment sites in a warm, professional and informed manner.
- Deliver compelling and accurate narratives about MSF's humanitarian mission, current programmes and emergency responses in Eastern Africa and beyond, including health crises, conflict zones and outbreak responses.
- Create awareness of MSF's work among individuals who may not be familiar with the organisation or its operations.
- Listen to prospective donors, answer questions accurately, handle objections professionally and invite interested individuals to make a regular monthly giving commitment or single gift.
- Process donor sign-ups using only MSF-approved forms or digital tools and approved donation channels.
- Meet agreed daily Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for donor sign-ups and quality of engagement.

***Donor Data, Quality & Follow-up***

- Capture and record donor information, consent and other required details in line with MSF donor management and data protection protocols.
- Ensure all information submitted through approved sign-up tools is complete, accurate and legible.
- Identify and appropriately refer donor enquiries, complaints or requests that cannot be resolved within the scope of the role.
- Provide timely feedback on recurring donor questions, objections, public perceptions and field-level learning to the supervisor.

***Team Participation & Field Operations***

- Work as part of the four-person F2F pilot team and contribute to a positive, target-driven and collaborative team environment.
- Attend and actively participate in all required training sessions, briefings, coaching sessions and debrief meetings.
- Follow the agreed deployment schedule and field procedures, including the structured Friday, Saturday and Sunday working pattern during the pilot.
- Maintain professional conduct, appropriate MSF visibility and a safe and respectful presence at all assigned locations.
- Report daily activity, donor sign-ups, contacts, challenges and any incidents through the required reporting tools.

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Maintaining honest, transparent, and respectful conduct in all donor interactions.
- Never making false or exaggerated claims about MSF's work to secure a donation.
- Handling donor personal data responsibly and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation and MSF procedures.
- Immediately reporting any safeguarding concerns, complaints, misconduct or other serious incidents to the supervisor.
- Embed duty of care principles into all initiatives

## ***Qualifications***

**Education**

- Minimum qualification of a Diploma or equivalent.
- Fluency in English and Swahili; additional languages are an asset.

**Experience**

- A minimum of 1-year relevant experience
- Prior experience in sales, customer engagement, fundraising or community outreach is a priority.

**Competencies**

- **Technical Competencies**
    - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to confidently and empathetically engage strangers in public spaces.
    - Genuine commitment to humanitarian values and alignment with MSF's principles of independence, impartiality and neutrality.
    - Resilience, self-motivation and the ability to work effectively in a target-driven environment, including handling rejection positively.
    - Professional, trustworthy, and respectful approach to working with members of the public and handling donor information
- **Behavioral/General Competencies**
    - Commitment to MSF principles
    - Analytical Thinking
    - Planning and Organizing
    - Results and Quality Orientation
    - Teamwork and Cooperation
    - Initiative and Innovation
    - Networking and Building Relationships
    - Service Orientation
    - Ethics: High ethical standards and a commitment to protecting the data of individuals and furthering MSF mandate.

## ***Conditions and Benefits:***

- **Job Location**: MSF Eastern Africa office in Nairobi (Kenya).
- **Contract**: 1- year renewable Full-time contract.
- **Start date**: As Soon As Possible.
- **Salary:** An annual salary of **EUR 8,534 at HQ Grade 2** based on a full-time appointment with an annual increment of 2% every year up to a maximum of 10 years.
- **Work-life balance financial benefit;** ranging between **EUR 247 to 295/month** based on individual & administrative status. This amount may be used to cover accommodation and utilities, transportation, etc.
- **Other benefits include;** 25 days of annual leave, Employer Pension contribution and medical insurance cover (staff and family) based on MSF EA terms/conditions.

title: Líder de Protección - Santa Bárbara del Zulia
body:
El Consejo Dánes para refugiados es una de las ONG humanitarias líderes en el mundo, que trabaja en más de 40 países para brindar asistencia y protección adecuadas a refugiados, solicitantes de asilo, desplazados internos, retornados, personas en movimiento y población local vulnerable/comunidades de acogida. Actualmente, DRC está buscando un **Líder de Equipo de Protección**  altamente calificado con sede en **Santa Bárbara del Zulia, Venezuela.**

**Acerca del trabajo:**

DRC está administrando sus operaciones en Venezuela, bajo la dirección de la oficina de país en Caracas y tres oficinas de campo ubicadas en los estados de Sucre, Apure y Zulia. DRC Venezuela está implementando actividades como monitoreo de protección, asistencia legal, asistencia de protección individual para PWSN, sesiones informativas para PoC, prevención de trata de personas, rehabilitación de infraestructura de salud y seguridad alimentaria.

**Objetivo del cargo:**

El TLP- CATATUMBO tendrá su sede en la oficina ubicada en el municipio Colon, específicamente en Santa Barbara del Zulia y bajo la supervisión del Gerente de Protección, apoyará la implementación de todos los objetivos de Protección de los proyectos de DRC, además de asegurar la calidad de la planificación, implementación y seguimiento de todos los aspectos técnicos de las actividades de protección que está implementando DRC en el Sur del Lago de Maracaibo, brindando apoyo al Gerente de Protección en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de buenas relaciones con las personas de interés, los actores interesados relevantes y otros actores humanitarios, para asegurar la implementación y coordinación necesaria para las actividades de protección de DRC y en la preparación de informes de protección requeridos. Adicionalmente, el TLP- Catatumbo será responsable de la gestión directa de todos los asistentes y oficiales de protección y de asistencia legal.

**Responsabilidades:**

**Sectoriales:**

- Incidencia sobre los derechos de las personas de interés en el contexto de su desplazamiento, facilitación del acceso a los servicios básicos, asistencia de protección individual basada en los riesgos de protección, asistencia legal, protección basada en comunidad, remisiones seguras, monitoreo de los derechos y sensibilización sobre los derechos con las comunidades de acogida y otros actores.

**Implementación del Proyecto de Protección**

- Participar en la implementación de actividades generales de protección de acuerdo con los objetivos acordados
- Monitorear y documentar continuamente las necesidades de las personas de interés
- Supervisar y analizar las tendencias a través la lectura de datos cuantitativos y cualitativos recopilados por el equipo de protección En el Catatumbo y municipios aledaños para fines de gestión, programa y promoción.
- Coordinar, planificar y monitorear las actividades de los equipos de protección, de asistencia legal de terreno y Protección Basada en Comunidad (CBP).
- Organizar talleres en coordinación con el Gerente de Protección para fortalecer las competencias de los oficiales de protección, de los equipos de otras áreas programáticas del DRC en el Sur del Lago y socios locales.
- Supervisar las actividades de asistencia legal, con el apoyo de los oficiales de asistencia legal cuando sea posible, garantizar la prestación puntual de los servicios.
- Apoyar las actividades de Protección Basada en comunidad, organizar e implementar las actividades pertinentes en las comunidades asignadas.
- Sistematizar la ruta de atención interna y externa, para fortalecer el sistema de remisiones.
- Garantizar la seguridad y confidencialidad de la información recopilada de acuerdo con el código de conducta de DRC, el protocolo de intercambio de información y las directrices pertinentes del jefe de línea.
- Orientación general y apoyo al personal de protección para identificar las necesidades de asistencia de protección comunitaria, a través de discusiones de grupos focales, observación directa, entrevistas formales e informales, utilizando un enfoque de edad, genero, diversidad y recomendar el mejor tipo de asistencia para abordar esas necesidades.
- Mantener una cooperación estrecha con las contrapartes gubernamentales y los actores humanitarios para fortalecer la ruta publica, así como la ruta de la cooperación humanitaria en el marco del mecanismo de remisión establecido.
- Elaborar y consolidar informes semanales y mensuales de alta calidad en base a los datos cuantitativo y cualitativo recopilados en el monitoreo de protección
- Supervisar las bases de datos y garantizar el mantenerlos con la información actualizada, correcta y organizada
- Garantizar la correcta limpieza de la base de datos del monitoreo de protección para permitir la elaboración de los informes mensuales.

**Programación y Operaciones**

- Asegurar la implementación eficiente y efectiva del programa
- Elaborar informes y participar en la escritura de propuestas y presupuestos mensuales / trimestrales / anuales para donantes.
- Gestionar y supervisar las actividades cotidianas del proyecto para garantizar que se ejecutan de acuerdo con los objetivos del proyecto, el plan de trabajo y las directrices y procedimientos de DRC.
- Realizar visitas periódicas a los emplazamientos sobre el terreno asignado y apoyar al personal de protección y de asistencia legal a sus actividades.
- Organizar y asegurar el diseño e implementación correcta de sesiones de sensibilización y campañas de información para personas de interés y comunidades de acogida.
- Identificar a las personas vulnerables según los criterios fijados por DRC y asegurar acciones apropiadas, incluidas las referencias a servicios especializados.
- Liderar el equipo de protección en la realización del monitoreo de protección, evaluaciones rápidas de protección, identificación de PDI, remisiones y entrega de Asistencia Individual de Protección (IPA).
- Gestión y control de presupuesto de las líneas programáticas.

**Coordinación y representación.**

- Mantenerse en contacto con las autoridades locales, los proveedores de servicios y los actores humanitarios para apoyar el mapeo de los servicios y el desarrollo de rutas de atención efectivas.
- Colaborar con expertos técnicos internos y externos en temas relevantes del sector
- Representar a DRC en reuniones internas y externas, de coordinación técnica relevantes, etc.
- Contribuir con la coordinación y buenas relaciones de trabajo, de manera, constructiva, solidaria y eficaz entre los equipos y las oficinas de DRC, tanto del estado Zulia como de otros estados del país, garantizando la eficacia entre los equipos de protección y otros departamentos, bajo la coordinación del gerente de protección.
- Asegurar la integración con otros sectores de DRC.

**Desarrollo del proyecto**

- Preparar planes de trabajo por el equipo de protección, PBC y asistencia legal
- Apoyar al Gerente de Protección en la preparación y desarrollo de planes de trabajo a largo plazo
- Participar en el desarrollo de herramientas de proyectos.
- Organizar y dirigir la implementación del monitoreo de protección
- Asegurar la actualización de las bases de datos de las remisiones e IPA, así como la revisión de la base de datos del monitoreo de protección.

**Logística / Finanzas**

**Experiencia y Competencias Técnicas**

- Mínimo 2 o 3 años de experiencia relevante en protección humanitaria, relacionado a una ONG, agencia de la ONU u otra organización sin fines de lucro;
- Experiencia de terreno y de trabajo en protección en zonas vulnerables de ciudades.
- Experiencia de trabajo en asistencia legal y protección basada en comunidad.
- Experiencia en la supervisión de equipo y preparación de planes de trabajo.
- Excelente experiencia y capacidad para entrevistar a personas de todas las edades y procedencias
- Excelente habilidad y experiencia progresa en el manejo de base de datos y uso de Excel
- Experiencia en el análisis de datos cuantitativos y cualitativos.
- Habilidades de escritura por encima del promedio.
- Excelente habilidad en MS Word y PowerPoint
- Experiencia en la producción de material técnico (material de capacitación, herramientas de protección, informes, documentos, etc.);
- Habilidades y experiencia en capacitación y desarrollo de capacidades de personal inexperto.
- Experiencia con medidas de responsabilidad y cumplimiento con los requisitos de DRC y sus donantes.

***Deseable:***

- Carácter diplomático.
- Capacidad para gestionar las prioridades en competencia y cumplir con los plazos.
- Capacidad de crear buen ambiente de equipo.
- Dominio de la lengua inglés es una ventaja.

**Educación**

- Diploma o título profesional pertinente en ciencias políticas, derecho, trabajo social, desarrollo internacional, psicología, derechos humanos o áreas relacionadas.

**Idiomas**

- Español

**Ofrecemos**

- La oportunidad de pertenecer a una de las mejores ONGs a nivel mundial.

**Competencias Básicas de DRC**

- **Lograr la excelencia**: centrarse en alcanzar resultados y garantizar procesos eficientes.

- **Tomar la iniciativa**: tomar posesión e iniciativa mientras se busca la innovación.

**Proceso de solicitud:** Todos los solicitantes deben cargar una carta de presentación (máx. 1 página) y un CV actualizado (**máx. 2 páginas, sin soportes**) en español, en la plataforma de empleo de DRC. Las solicitudes enviadas por correo electrónico no serán consideradas.

title: Donor Relationship Officer
body:
## **MSF Eastern Africa is looking for a Donor Relationship Officer**

*Do your skills and experience not precisely match the requirements? At MSF EA, we strive to create a safe, diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing the need to increase access to professional opportunities for historically underrepresented groups. If you're interested in this position but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the selection criteria, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the ideal candidate for this or other positions.*

*Firmly committed to safeguarding patients, community members, staff, and all those in contact with the organization from all forms of abuse, including sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (SEAH), we will take all necessary steps, through rigorous vetting processes, to ensure that confirmed perpetrators of abuse do not join the organization.*

*For this position, contact level with patients and children is categorized as **Low Risk** and will be monitored with this in regard.*

## ***Introduction***

Médecins Sans Frontières/Doctors Without Borders (MSF) is an international independent medical humanitarian organisation that provides assistance to people affected by conflicts, epidemics, and natural or human-made disasters and excluded from healthcare. We provide this assistance without discrimination, irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation.

## ***About MSF Eastern Africa***

MSF Eastern Africa is the regional institutional office of MSF. It focuses on representation and networking, recruiting and supporting staff from the region, communications and fundraising, as well as working on other dossiers of importance to MSF such as Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI), Data Protection, mutualization, training, medical operational support and environmental health.

## ***Rationale/Objective for Position***

The Donor Relationship Officer is responsible for advancing the cultivation, donor acquisition, stewardship, and growth of donor relationships across the region, with a particular focus on Islamic philanthropy.

This position will be ***hierarchically*** and ***functionally*** accountable to the ***Donor Relationship Manager***.

## ***Tasks & Responsibilities***

**Donor Acquisition, Engagement & Stewardship**

- Support acquisition, donor engagement and stewardship for individual, corporate, foundations and major donors, with priority focus on Islamic philanthropy.
- Build and manage a personal portfolio of high-value and prospective donors, supporting in development of tailored cultivation and stewardship plans for each.
- Draft and oversee personalised donor communications, thank-you letters, impact reports, and stewardship materials.
- Support in Planning and coordinating donor touchpoints, including one-on-one meetings, cultivation events, donor briefings, and field or site visits.
- Track engagement outcomes and donor satisfaction and adjust stewardship approaches based on donor feedback and giving behaviour.

**Islamic Philanthropy Strategy & Partnerships**

- Contribute to the Implementation of MSF Eastern Africa's Islamic philanthropy strategy, including annual targets, priority segments, and channel plans.
- Identify, map, and build lasting relationships with Islamic philanthropy networks, Zakat institutions, Waqf funds, mosques, and Muslim foundations relevant to MSF's work.
- Support in designing, and implementation of Ramadan- and Zakat-specific fundraising appeals and campaigns, working closely with Communications, and Programmes and fundraising teams.
- Represent MSF in negotiations and support in management of partnerships related to Islamic charitable organizations, faith-based community groups, and diaspora networks. e.g. Somali diaspora
- Ensuring all fundraising materials and messaging are culturally and theologically sensitive, accurate, and aligned with Islamic giving principles; act as the organisation's internal reference point on Islamic philanthropy practice.
- Represent MSF at relevant faith-based, philanthropic, and community forums, strengthening MSF’s profile and credibility among Muslim donors, Islamic charitable organizations, Zakat institutions, and other Islamic philanthropy networks.

**Business Development & Revenue Growth**

- Identify and pursue new donor prospects and partnership opportunities to grow income against agreed annual targets.
- Develop compelling funding proposals, concept notes, and pitch materials for individual donors, foundations, and institutions.
- Contribute to the wider Fundraising team's income diversification and long-term donor pipeline planning.

**Research, Reporting & Compliance**

- Lead prospect research on Islamic philanthropic organisations and high-net-worth Muslim donors across Eastern Africa.
- Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date donor records and activity in the CRM system and ensure data quality across the donor portfolio.
- Prepare regular briefing notes, performance reports, and presentations for senior management and the Fundraising team.
- Ensure all donor engagement and gift acceptance activity complies with MSF policy, relevant due diligence requirements, and applicable regulations.

**Team & Organisational Contribution**

- Support the professional development of interns or junior team members contributing to Islamic philanthropy and donor relations work.
- Collaborate closely with Communications, Programmes, and Finance to ensure donor-facing materials accurately reflect MSF's operations and impact.
- Contribute to broader Fundraising team strategy, planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Representing MSF EA in different platforms with the MSF movement when advised to

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Integrate EDI & Safeguarding aspects in area of work responsibility, including policies and practices.
- Recognize, respond, and document any form of abuse or inappropriate behaviour and alert the safeguarding unit of any suspected potential abuse.
- Proactively participate in the individual performance management process including objective setting, performance monitoring and performance evaluation.
- Embed duty of care principles into all initiatives, CRM administration, and staff relations.

## ***Qualifications***

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree in Development Studies, International Relations, Communications, Islamic Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
- Strong, demonstrable knowledge of Islamic philanthropy mechanisms- including Zakat, Sadaqah, and Waqf; and of faith-aligned giving practices is a core requirement of this role.

**Experience**

- A minimum of 2 years' professional experience in fundraising, donor relations, business development, or partnership management, ideally within an international NGO or humanitarian context.
- Experience with reporting and donor management tools like CRM, Mailchimp is preferred.

**Competencies**

- ***Technical Competencies***
    - Proven track record of building major donor relationships and securing or growing philanthropic income.
    - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic proficiency is a strong asset.
    - High level of cultural and theological sensitivity, with the ability to engage respectfully and credibly across diverse faith communities.
    - Strong stakeholder networking, negotiation, and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior donors and institutional partners.
    - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
    - Excellent organisational skills, sound judgement, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with a high degree of autonomy.
- ***Behavioral/General Competencies***
    - Commitment to MSF principles
    - Analytical Thinking
    - Planning and Organizing
    - Results and Quality Orientation
    - Teamwork and Cooperation
    - Initiative and Innovation
    - Networking and Building Relationships
    - Service Orientation
    - Ethics: High ethical standards and a commitment to protecting the data of individuals and furthering MSF mandate.

## ***Conditions and Benefits:***

- **Job Location**: MSF Eastern Africa office in Nairobi (Kenya).
- **Contract**: 1-year renewable Full-time contract.
- **Start date**: As Soon As Possible.
- **Salary:** An annual salary of **EUR 23,296 at HQ Grade 7** based on a full-time appointment with an annual increment of 2% every year up to a maximum of 10 years.
- **Work-life balance financial benefit;** ranging between **EUR 247 to 295/month** based on individual & administrative status. This amount may be used to cover accommodation and utilities, transportation, etc.
- **Other benefits include;** 25 days of annual leave, Employer Pension contribution and medical insurance cover (staff and family) based on MSF EA terms/conditions.

title: Chargé de financements (F/H) - République Démocratique de Congo
body:
Vous souhaitez intégrer une association militante et agir concrètement pour plus de justice sociale ?

Médecins du Monde agit depuis plus de 40 ans pour soigner les populations les plus vulnérables, dénoncer les entraves à l’accès aux soins et faire évoluer durablement les politiques de santé.

En France et dans près de 30 pays, nos actions s’articulent autour de six combats politiques :

- droits et santé sexuels et reproductifs (dont le droit à l’avortement)
- migration, exil, droits et santé
- réduction des risques
- santé environnement
- droits et système de santé
- espaces humanitaires

## Médecins du Monde en République Démocratique du Congo

Présente en RDC depuis 1994, Médecins du Monde France (MdM) met en œuvre des programmes de santé et d’action humanitaire dans les provinces de Kinshasa, du Nord-Kivu et du Tanganyika. Ses interventions s’articulent autour de trois axes principaux : la santé sexuelle et reproductive, la santé environnementale et la réponse aux urgences humanitaires.

À Kinshasa, MdM soutient l’accès à la planification familiale, aux droits et à la santé sexuels et reproductifs, ainsi que des actions de prévention en santé environnementale visant à réduire l’impact des pesticides sur la santé des populations. Dans les provinces du Tanganyika et du Nord-Kivu, l’organisation intervient auprès des populations affectées par les conflits, les déplacements de population et les crises sanitaires, en renforçant l’accès à des soins de santé primaires, à la santé sexuelle et reproductive, à la nutrition, ainsi qu’à la prise en charge des violences basées sur le genre. MdM participe également à la réponse aux épidémies (choléra, rougeole, Ebola).

MdM travaille en étroite collaboration avec les autorités sanitaires congolaises, les programmes nationaux du Ministère de la Santé et de nombreuses organisations de la société civile. Dans les années à venir, MdM prévoit notamment de développer un programme de prévention du cancer du col de l’utérus.

Dans un contexte humanitaire complexe et évolutif, marqué par des besoins importants en santé et en protection, la mission RDC poursuit le développement de ses programmes d’urgence et de renforcement des systèmes de santé, avec le soutien de plusieurs bailleurs institutionnels internationaux.

## Pourquoi nous avons besoin de vous

Vous avez pour mission principale d’appuyer les activités de la mission et de préparer tous les dossiers liés à la gestion des subventions en RDC. Vous coordonnez l’écriture des propositions de projets et des rapports d’activité à destination des bailleurs de fonds institutionnels et des fondations privées.

Vous participez à la réflexion stratégique de la mission en termes de financements bailleurs et assurez la diffusion des règles bailleurs auprès des équipes. Vous participez au reporting et à la communication interne et externe de la mission.

## Vos missions

**Relations bailleurs**

- Assurer la veille sur les exigences et réglementations des bailleurs et en garantir la bonne appropriation par les équipes
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de financement en collaboration avec le siège et les équipes concernées
- Développer et entretenir les relations avec les bailleurs afin de soutenir la stratégie de financement de la mission

**Développement des propositions de projets**

- Coordonner l’élaboration des propositions de projets en veillant à leur conformité avec la stratégie de MdM en RDC et les attentes des bailleurs
- Accompagner les équipes dans la construction des cadres logiques, budgets et autres composantes techniques des projets
- Piloter la rédaction, la consolidation et le dépôt des propositions dans le respect des échéances

**Reporting et gestion des subventions**

- Planifier et coordonner la production des rapports destinés aux bailleurs et au siège
- Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et le respect des délais de reporting
- Assurer le suivi des financements et mettre à jour les outils de gestion et de suivi des subventions

**Suivi, évaluation et conformité des projets**

- Accompagner les équipes dans le suivi des activités financées par les bailleurs
- Veiller au respect des engagements contractuels et des exigences de conformité
- Contribuer à la préparation et au bon déroulement des audits internes et externes

**Communication institutionnelle et valorisation des projets**

- Piloter la communication interne et externe de la mission auprès des bailleurs, partenaires, autorités et médias
- Concevoir et coordonner les outils de valorisation des projets et assurer leur visibilité
- Conseiller la coordination sur les enjeux de communication, de réputation et de représentation institutionnelle

**Veille stratégique et analyse du contexte**

- Assurer une veille continue sur le contexte politique, sécuritaire, sanitaire et social de la RDC
- Suivre les évolutions des thématiques stratégiques et de plaidoyer portées par la mission
- Produire des analyses et notes de synthèse pour éclairer les décisions de coordination et le développement de nouveaux projets

## Vos collègues

Sous la supervision du coordinateur général, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe de coordination, les équipes programmes présentes du siège, de Kinshasa et des bases de MdM au niveau du terrain.

En RDC, deux sections de MdM sont présentes, MdM France (MdM-F) et MdM Belgique (MdM-Be), qui travaillent en réseau dans diverses régions du pays (Kinshasa, Nord et Sud Kivu, Tanganyika) notamment dans des contextes de crise et de développement, en milieu rural et urbain. A l’Est du pays, le réseau MdM a décidé de réorganiser sa répartition géographique afin de donner une couverture plus large des besoins des populations dans le pays. Pour cela, MdM-Be se positionne sur le Sud-Kivu, MdM-F intervient dans le Tanganyika, Nord Kivu et Kinshasa.

En conséquence, vous contribuerez à des démarches communes vis-à-vis de certains bailleurs de fonds, dans l’optique de travailler en consortium.

## PROFIL

**Vous êtes la bonne personne si**

- Vous avez un niveau Master en Relations Internationales Humanitaire, développement, coopération
- Vous disposez d'un an minimum d’expérience de terrain avec des ONG internationales (dont stage) en écriture de propositions de projets et rapports
- Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de la méthodologie de projet, des bailleurs de fonds
- Vous avez des connaissances de base dans les domaines des projets de la mission (SSR et/ou Urgences)
- Par ailleurs, vous savez faire preuve de flexibilité, patience, réactivité et capacité d’écoute
- Vous avez démontré à maintes reprise votre esprit d’initiative et de synthèse, votre rigueur et votre autonomie
- Vous avez également un bon relationnel, savez communiquer et travailler en équipe (interculturelles et multidisciplinaires), avec des multiples interlocuteurs
- Vous êtes capable de gérer les priorités et à travailler sur des dossiers de manière concomitante
- Vous avez compétent en création de supports de communication
- Vous avez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et analytiques
- Vous maîtrisez le Pack Office et les réseaux sociaux
- Vous parlez courament français et anglais (minimum C1)

## VOS CONDITIONS D'EMPLOI

**Contrat & statut :**

- Salaire brut mensuel 3 069 €
- CDDU de 12 mois à pourvoir dès que possible
- Statut employé
- Départ seul

**Cadre de travail :**

- Poste basé à Kinshasa, RDC
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir dans toutes les zones d’intervention

**Les avantages :**

- 13e mois (pour les salarié.e.s ayant plus de 6 mois d’ancienneté)
- Prime d’expatriation de 10% du salaire brut par mois
- Prise en charge du transport (domicile – mission), des visas, des vaccins
- Hébergement: logement en guesthouse
- Assurance santé (cotisations mensuelles couvertes à 50% par MdM et 50% par le salarié)
- Assurance rapatriement
- MdM favorise la formation et la mobilité interne

**Les indispensables :**

- 5 semaines de congés + 22,5 RTT par an
- Engagement fort en faveur de l’inclusion et de la lutte contre toutes les discriminations
- Plus d’infos : [https://www.medecinsdumonde.org/nous-rejoindre/travail-humanitaire/](https://www.medecinsdumonde.org/nous-rejoindre/travail-humanitaire/)

**Diversité et inclusion**

MdM s’engage pour l’insertion des personnes en situation de handicap et lutte contre toutes les discriminations.

Si vous bénéficiez d’une reconnaissance de la qualité de travailleur.se handicapé.e et/ou si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement de poste, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
