title: Rwanda Driver (Fixed-Term)
body:
## About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our [Why Work Here](https://oneacrefund.org/careers/why-work-here) blog post.

Our Rwanda program, founded in 2007 is our largest and operates under the local brand Tubura. We have more than 3,000 staff across all four provinces of Rwanda, as well as in Kigali. Together, we served more than 2.8 million farmers in 2024. We work closely with the government to support national efforts to improve food security. Additionally, we help channel funding and resources to promising agri-SMEs, supporting farmers by providing a market for high-impact crops such as coffee, avocado, and chili.

## About the Role

Seeking a driver to transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between OAF sites, maintain the fleet and cargo in excellent condition, and provide insights on truck operations and charging to inform future electric truck ownership.

## Responsibilities

Cargo Transport

- Transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between assigned OAF sites, ensuring delivery strictly to the specified locations within set timelines.
- Collaborate with the warehouse team to load, offload, and reload trucks, verifying that the physical cargo matches the exact quantity and quality stated on delivery documents.
- Secure all materials in transit using appropriate equipment to prevent loss, theft, tampering, or damage (e.g., perforations, wet bags, or torn stitching).
- Proactively gather information regarding the location and accessibility of field sites and chargers within the assigned district prior to departure.

Vehicle Maintenance

- Conduct weekly vehicle checks, perform minor repairs, and submit maintenance requests to your manager to ensure that the vehicle under their care is kept in good running condition at all times.
- Mitigate damage to the truck by avoiding risky routes or driving techniques.
- Ensure safety and custody of the vehicles including tools.
- Ensure availability of all the required documents/supplies including vehicle insurance, registration, first aid kit, and necessary spare parts in the assigned vehicle.
- Ensure that, in the event of an accident involving the vehicle, the necessary steps required by rules and regulations are followed.

Documentation & Communication

- Accurately manage all delivery documents, including Delivery Notes, Load Cards, and Truck Management Sheets (TMS). Return fully signed delivery documents to your manager within one (1) business day of delivery.
- Obtain official signatures from authorized OAF representatives at both the originating and destination sites to confirm the exact weight/number of inputs dispatched and received.
- Immediately notify your manager via text (or call for urgent cases) in the event of accidents, field staff unavailability, data discrepancies, charging problems, mechanical problems, adverse weather, route accessibility issues, data discrepancies, or if any party refuses to sign the delivery documents.
- Communicate regularly relevant trial information, such as GPS coordinates, KM range, battery levels, charging experience, driving experience, road quality, etc.
- Ensure that all required driving training is successfully completed and certifications are kept up to date

## Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

## Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the [general qualifications we look for](https://oneacrefund.org/work-with-us/application-process/qualifications/). For this role specifically, you will have:

- Valid category C driver’s licence
- Experience driving cargo trucks on dirt roads outside of Kigali
- Working knowledge of local roads and routes, ability to utilize maps / GPS systems
- Working knowledge of electric vehicle mechanics (truck maintenance, interpret truck KM range / battery life)
- Sound knowledge of road safety regulations
- Effective communication skills (verbal and written) in Kinyarwanda
- Punctual and reliable, customer service

## Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

## Job Location

Kigali, Rwanda

## Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

## Contract Duration

3 months

## Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Rwanda.

## Application Deadline

23 December 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

*One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @*[*oneacrefund.org*](http://oneacrefund.org/) *address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), **but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.***

*Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.*

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.*

title: Finance Manager - EA
body:
## **MSF Eastern Africa is looking for a Finance Manager**

*Do your skills and experience not precisely match the requirements? At MSF EA, we strive to create a safe, diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing the need to increase access to professional opportunities for historically underrepresented groups. If you're interested in this position but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the selection criteria, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the ideal candidate for this or other positions.*

*Firmly committed to safeguarding patients, community members, staff, and all those in contact with the organization from all forms of abuse, including sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (SEAH), we will take all necessary steps, through rigorous vetting processes, to ensure that confirmed perpetrators of abuse do not join the organization.*

*For this position, contact level with patients and children is categorized as **Low** risk and will be monitored with this in regard.*

## ***Introduction***

Médecins Sans Frontières/Doctors Without Borders (MSF) is an international independent medical humanitarian organisation that provides assistance to people affected by conflicts, epidemics, and natural or human-made disasters and excluded from healthcare. We provide this assistance without discrimination, irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation.

## ***About MSF Eastern Africa***

MSF Eastern Africa is the regional institutional office of MSF. It focuses on representation and networking, recruiting and supporting staff from the region, communications and fundraising, as well as working on other dossiers of importance to MSF such as Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI), Data Protection, mutualization, training, medical operational support and environmental health.

## ***Rationale/Objective for Position***

The Finance Manager is responsible for coordinating, monitoring, and implementing financial and legal management in accordance with legal obligations and MSF standards and protocols. The job holder is also responsible for ensuring the integrity of MSF EA financial reporting, in accordance with legal obligations and MSF standards and protocols.

This position will be **hierarchically** and **functionally** accountable to **Head of Finance and Services.**

## ***Tasks & Responsibilities***

**International Reporting**

- Pre-reconciliation of receivable and payables of sections with finance managers of other sections in preparation for the annual closure exercise.
- Process International Office entries in the end of year package.
- Report on monthly balances in Monthly Money report.
- Update M-package and Budget package in the system monthly.
- Responsible for yearly closure and reporting to the International Office (IO) on final landing.
- Responsible for the international combination process including accurate reconciliations with the IO team.
- Provide clear and timely responses to queries from IO.
- Ensure all Transformational Investment Capacity (TIC) requirements for documentation of expenditures are met to facilitate attribution of expenses to donors when funding is obtained.
- Elaborate the lines for grants, regular analysis of the ongoing expenditure for adjustments and final reporting on the grants.

**Intersectional Hosting**

- Consult regularly with each hosting section to identify the finance needs and provide guidance on the process to be followed and departments that need to be involved.
- Define MSF EA finance hosting procedures and monitor the implementation of the same.
- Authorize advances, per diems and procurements for hosted sections in accordance with the needs of the section.
- Review the accounting, trace transactions for reinvoicing to hosted sections and execute the same.
- Responsible for receivables from sections including issuing monthly statement of accounts and follow up of payments/cash netting.
- Provide accurate and timely reporting on the financial activities/expenses of hosted sections and answer questions on their expenditure.
- Produce timely and accurate monthly reports on hosting for review with Head of Finance and Services.

**Monthly / Annual Closure**

- Run monthly depreciation ahead of the closures.
- Prepare Finance Situational Reports (Sitreps).
- Support the Accounting Team Leader in the monthly and annual accounting closures.
- Ensure monthly cash counts and reconciliations with the Accounting Team Leader.
- Ensure follow-up of VAT receivables.
- Support monthly reconciliations before closure.
- Manage the recurring entries overview on prepayments of rentals and insurance.
- Monitor receivables, identifying irrecoverable debts and propose write offs to the Head of Finance and Services.

**Compliance and Control**

- Validate invoices, purchase requests, purchase orders including following up on various International and Regional procurement matters as per authorization table.
- Submit compliance reports to MSF EA and relevant authorities.
- Oversee salary reconciliations, validate the final payroll in the system and statutory deductions before passing to the Accounting Team Leader for timely remittances.
- Be updated with policy changes within the country that affect MSF in general.
- In collaboration with the facilities department, update and maintain financial tracing of the Sections assets.

**Budgeting**

- Contribute to the improvement of the budgeting tool and propose changes for implementation by MSF EA.
- In close collaboration with the Accounting Team Leader, provide guidance and support on budgeting to the Heads of Department as directed by the Head of Finance and Services.
- Support with the review of guidelines and collection of information for budget and collection of information for monthly forecast preparation as guided by the Head of Finance and Services.

**Other Responsibilities**

- As part of Management Team Plus attend the periodic meetings and provide input for strategic & management issues.
- Act as a Bank signatory to MSF Spain South Sudan and Sudan accounts with current MSF Banker in Kenya.
- Participate in tender analysis with Logistics/Supply/HR team.
- In collaboration with the Accounting Team Leader prepare the RACI table, regularly updating it with changes and share with the team.
- Provide support to and coordinate finance staff for any finance allocation in Dynamics.
- Identify and perform relevant technical training for staff in finance.
- Update any commitments register from procurement.
- Gap fill for the Accounting Team Leader.
- Carry out any additional duties assigned by the Finance and Services Director.
- Integrate EDI & Safeguarding aspects in areas of responsibility, including policies and practices.
- Recognize, respond, and document any form of abuse or inappropriate behaviour and alert the safeguarding unit of any suspected potential abuse.
- Proactively participate in the individual performance management process including objective setting, performance monitoring and performance evaluation.
- Recognize and reinforce strong performance in supervisees; identify and encourage improvement where needed; and ensure quality and timely performance management process is carried out for supervisees.

## ***Qualifications***

**Education**

- A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
- Knowledge of MS Office Tools (PPT, Excel).
- Fluency in English is required, and knowledge of French and a third language is an added advantage.

**Experience**

- At least five (5) years of relevant experience in financial management preferably in the non-profit making sector, international organization.

**Competencies**

- ***Technical Competencies***
    - Familiarity with strategic orientation.
- ***Behavioral/General Competencies***
    - Proven leadership skills.
    - Commitment to MSF’s Principles.
    - Cross-cultural Awareness.
    - Strategic Vision.
    - Results and Quality Orientation.
    - Service Orientation.
    - Planning and Organizing.
    - Initiative and Innovation.
    - Teamwork and Cooperation.
    - Ethics: High ethical standards and a commitment to protecting the data of individuals and furthering MSF mandate.

## ***Conditions and Benefits:*** 

- **Job Location**: MSF Eastern Africa office in Nairobi (Kenya).
- **Contract**: Full time,3-year contract, renewable.
- **Start date**: January 2027.
- **Salary:** An annual salary of **EUR 27145 at HQ Grade 8** based on a full-time appointment with an annual increment of 2% every year up to a maximum of 10 years.
- **Work-life balance financial benefit;** ranging between **EUR 620 to 1,159/month** based on individual & administrative status. This amount may be used to cover accommodation and utilities, transportation, etc.
- **Other benefits include;**
    - **Annual Leave:** 25 days of annual leave per year.
    - **Other Holidays:** sick leave, circumstantial leave, maternity leave (21 weeks), paternity leave (4 weeks), own affairs days off, etc.
    - **Employer Pension contribution**: 10% of basic salary.
    - **International insurance** for both medical and disability.
    - **Relocation support**; based on MSF EA terms/conditions.
    - **Work-life balance**: Daily flexi-hours and 2 days working from home possible.
    - **School fees benefits**: for eligible dependents, based on individual & administrative status.
    - **Diverse team composition**; Collaborate with a global network of talented professionals, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise from around the world.
    - **Career Development**: MSF provides many learning resources (online learning resources, regular trainings – including language, Peer to peer learning.
    - **Mobility**: You will have opportunities to travel abroad for work, meetings, trainings and workshops; giving you a chance to experience different cultures and broaden your professional network.
    - **Annual home leave ticket**: To be taken once every year for both staff and eligible dependents back to their home country for vacation. Only applicable to non-Kenyans and based on individual & administrative status.

title: Tupande Transport and Dispatch Senior Supervisor
body:
## About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our [Why Work Here](https://oneacrefund.org/careers/why-work-here) blog post.

Our Kenya program, founded in 2006, operates under the local brand Tupande. Close to 500 staff in our Kakamega headquarters support 1,747 field staff and serve more than 1 million farmers. In Nairobi, around 50 staff support global functions like procurement, recruitment, government relations, and communications.

## About the Role

Seeking an operational leader with 2-3 years experience to direct fleet, dispatch, and vendor operations at Tupande, driving safety, cost optimization, and team performance.

## Responsibilities

Fleet & Dispatch Operations

- Oversee daily internal and third-party transport operations, ensuring high standards of service, efficient request fulfillment, and optimal vehicle maintenance.
- Review staff taxi requests for accuracy and tracking data to optimize driver assignments and reduce costs.
- Coordinate internal vehicle and driver allocation to meet staff transportation needs effectively.
- Maintain the taxi vendor database and serve as the primary point of contact for feedback and operational issue resolution.
- Utilize Fleet Management System (FMS) tools to track fleet utilization, manage assignments, and achieve established KPIs.
- Ensure professional and timely communication of trip and driver details to staff and vendors, optimizing routes to reduce overall trip costs.

Request Management

- Review staff taxi requests for accuracy and unique tracking data, following up on manager approvals to ensure compliance.
- Assign drivers efficiently by balancing routes and assignments to optimize vehicle use and minimize overall trip costs.
- Ensure professional and timely communication of trip and driver details to both staff and vendors.

Safety, Compliance, and Quality Control

- Coordinate and track weekly safety inspections for the Tupande fleet and quarterly safety checks for all third-party taxi vehicles to ensure they are roadworthy and compliant.
- Ensure total fleet compliance with safety regulations and organizational standards, including insurance, RSL, and speed governors.
- Implement safety protocols for vehicle inspections, driver behavior, and trip management to mitigate risks and enhance safety.

Cost Control

- Verify, review, and reconcile all transport-related receipts and payments against approved requests, flagging discrepancies or high costs.
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date taxi and fleet cost-tracking sheets to ensure data integrity.
- Generate weekly cost summaries for budget holder approval and process all transport payments, including maintenance, fuel, and vendor contracts.
- Submit validated payment documents to leadership for final approval, ensuring adherence to payment SLAs.
- Utilize Fleet Management System (FMS) tools to monitor expenditures, detect anomalies, and implement fraud mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement and Team Management

- Identify areas to reduce transport inefficiencies, eliminate duplicate workflows, or improve communication flows.
- Provide strategic feedback to improve the taxi dispatch system, fleet allocation, and overall transport protocols to better manage operational spend.
- Manage, mentor, and develop the Senior Transport Officers to build a high-performance culture.
- Identify and facilitate professional growth and development opportunities for direct reports

## Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

## Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the [general qualifications we look for](https://oneacrefund.org/work-with-us/application-process/qualifications/). For this role specifically, you will have:

Technical Skills:

- Fleet Management Systems (FMS): Advanced proficiency in tools to monitor fleet, track utilization, and generate operational reports.
- Workflow Management: Demonstrated ability to handle multi-step approval flows, driver assignments, and precise document tracking.
- Google Suite: Proficiency in Google Sheets to reconcile transport expenses, verify receipts, and maintain accurate cost-tracking logs.
- Expense Management & Reporting: Experience with verifying transport invoices, maintaining accurate cost records, and ensuring financial accuracy for department budgets.
- Budget Coordination: Ability to track and reconcile transport costs, verify receipts, and flag discrepancies to ensure spending stays within guidelines.
- Stakeholder Coordination: Strong communication skills to manage internal staff requests, external vendor relationships, and team leadership.

Knowledge and Understanding

- Compliance & Safety: Comprehensive understanding of transport regulations, safety standards, and insurance protocols.
- Budgetary Control: Knowledge of financial validation processes, anomaly detection, and fraud mitigation strategies.
- Operational Agility: Ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive logistical requests and urgent operational escalations.

## Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

## Job Location

Kakamega, Kenya

## Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

## Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya.

## Application Deadline

17 December 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

*One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @*[*oneacrefund.org*](http://oneacrefund.org/) *address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), **but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.***

*Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.*

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.*

title: Mitarbeiter Projektfinanzen (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
body:
Seit 1979 setzt sich die internationale Hilfsorganisation humedica mit Sitz in Kaufbeuren dafür ein, dass Menschen in Notlagen nicht nur überleben, sondern in ein würdevolles Leben zurückkehren können. Dies gelingt dank des großen Engagements von rund 85 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland, sowie einem internationalen Team und Hunderten ehrenamtlichen Helfern. Neutral und unabhängig, mit Herz und Professionalität, stehen wir in unseren weltweiten Projekten für die Verbesserung der Lebensbedingungen und eine gute gesundheitliche Versorgung ein. Dabei ist die christliche Nächstenliebe unser Leitmotiv.

Sie wollten schon immer mit Ihrer Tätigkeit das Leben anderer Menschen ins Positive verändern? Dann suchen wir Sie ​**zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt** als

## **Mitarbeiter Projektfinanzen (m/w/d) in Vollzeit**

- Durchführung des Projektfinanzcontrollings und Abrechnung von internationalen Projekten in verschiedenen Ländern im Bereich der humanitären Hilfe und der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit
